name: display-text
behavior: Displays instructional text in the script interface. Presentation and continuation are controlled by the host.

name: navigate
behavior: Requests the named navigation destination. The host resolves the destination and controls the resulting interaction.

name: navigate-refresh
behavior: Requests the named navigation destination with a dashboard refresh.

name: goto
behavior: Continues at the specified structured sequence without retaining a return position.

name: press-button
behavior: Requests the identified host button action. Availability and effects depend on the current interface.

name: input
purpose: Collects a value into a destination.
behavior: Collects input for the destination. Optional text supplies instructions. Continue advances to the next sequence; a selected configured choice instead supplies its sequence target.

name: prompt
behavior: Presents the available choices and continues at the selected choice target. At most one choice is the default.

name: move
purpose: Copies a value into a destination.
behavior: Copies or clears the selected destination. XML node values can remain node references when assigned to temporary variables.

name: conditional
purpose: Selects a true or false step destination.
behavior: Continues at trueTarget when the condition result equals true, or falseTarget otherwise. This structured form is distinct from textual branch, whose condition is lost during conversion.

name: focus
behavior: Places focus on the identified field and displays the supplied text. Continue advances to the next sequence; a selected configured choice instead supplies its sequence target.

name: math
behavior: Applies the specified arithmetic operation to the destination using the source value.

name: label
purpose: Marks a step with descriptive text.
behavior: Provides a structured sequence with descriptive text. Unlike a standalone textual label statement, this record occupies a position in the script.

name: height
behavior: Requests the script display height using the specified value and unit.

name: function
behavior: Invokes the named host function and continues at successTarget or errorTarget according to its outcome.

name: transfer-control
behavior: Starts a replacement script, clears the call stack and data areas, and retains temporary variables. The caller does not resume.

name: perform-script
purpose: Calls a script and retains a return position.
behavior: Calls the named script with shared temporary variables and data areas. Normal completion returns to the caller; termination or transfer in the callee can prevent return.

name: invoke-service-script
purpose: Invokes a service script with a data area.
behavior: Invokes the named service script with the supplied data area, then follows successTarget or errorTarget.

name: invoke-business-object
behavior: Requests the specified operation on the named business object using the supplied data area, then follows successTarget or errorTarget.

name: invoke-business-service
behavior: Invokes the named business service with the supplied data area, then follows successTarget or errorTarget.

name: invoke-map
behavior: Presents the named map, using a popup by default. A returned choice selects its configured sequence target; a return that matches no choice advances to the next sequence. Closing the map is a separate path and can stop execution when no default continuation is configured. The host controls interaction and resulting data.

name: for
behavior: Visits the selected nodes, starting the body at the following instruction and continuing to exitTarget when complete. The loop variable is cleared after an iterated loop finishes; that rule does not establish cleanup for an empty selection.

name: terminate
behavior: Stops the whole BPA, including active callers. Optional errorScript describes a host error action outside this profile; it does not give textual terminate an error payload.

name: generate-object-map
behavior: Requests a generated edit map for the named business object. The default display target is the page.

name: generate-service-map
behavior: Requests a generated edit map for the named business service. The default display target is the page.

name: generate-data-map
behavior: Requests a generated edit map for the named data area. The default display target is the page.

name: generate-script-map
behavior: Requests a generated edit map for the named service script. The default display target is the page.

name: declare-object
behavior: Creates a data-area alias using the named business-object schema. Redeclaration replaces the alias's current data; the host supplies schema details and defaults.

name: declare-grouped-object
purpose: Declares a grouped business-object data area.
behavior: Creates a data-area alias using a grouped business-object schema. Redeclaration replaces the alias's current data; the host supplies schema details and defaults.

name: declare-service
behavior: Creates a data-area alias using the named business-service schema. Redeclaration replaces the alias's current data; the host supplies schema details and defaults.

name: declare-data
behavior: Creates an alias using the named data-area schema. Redeclaration replaces the alias's current data; the host supplies schema details and defaults.

name: declare-script
behavior: Creates a data-area alias using the named service-script schema. Redeclaration replaces the alias's current data; the host supplies schema details and defaults.

name: declare-map
behavior: Creates a data-area alias using the named map schema. Redeclaration replaces the alias's current data; the host supplies schema details and defaults.

name: default-variable
behavior: Supplies a temporary-variable default without unconditionally replacing an existing value.

name: edit-data
behavior: Supplies a body of textual statements for expansion into browser instructions. Labels, variables, and data areas are shared with the surrounding script; no outer edit data wrapper belongs in this body. A disabled whole step is still parsed and expanded, and its labels remain registered and subject to validation. Disabling does not hide malformed syntax or unresolved or duplicate labels.
